review_scope: Normative design only. No graph binding/closure, Reader ACL, implementation, physical authentication selection or runtime proof.

findings.issue: Initial S07 input and transformation description covered config assertions only, while frozen FUNCTION_CONFIG_SAFE also needs static-dependency and owner/SD-path evidence.
findings.resolution: Revised S07 explicitly consumes typed catalog frame and protected source-expanded manifests and evaluates all three conjuncts. Incomplete closure yields UNKNOWN. S07 does not depend on S08 output, avoiding a circular acceptance condition.

findings.issue: Initial S02 source-field list included two protected stats fields and wording could mislabel deliberate masking as observed SQL NULL.
findings.resolution: Revised actual source authority reads only four public roster fields. Protected output slots are explicitly POLICY_NOT_ACQUIRED, not observed SQL NULL or denial. Existing bridge-selected facts retain independent provenance; no fill of raw protected slots.

findings.issue: A fixed opcode facade alone cannot prove no generic SQL path through a custodied ordinary-role PostgreSQL session.
findings.resolution: Source capability contract now confines the protocol handle, forbids caller statement/identifier/protocol access, and requires enumeration of every reachable transport send/prepare/execute API. Arbitrary PUBLIC-executable function paths must reject. Actual role/PUBLIC ACL invariants remain unproved and deferred explicitly.

assessments.evidence: Eight contracts preserve ordinary metadata, volatile public stats, self-session bridge, config sanitizer, exact body digest, frame codec, config predicate and graph predicate boundaries. Fields are grouped rather than assigned one step each. Distinct transformations/predicate families justify separate pure steps despite common zero-source-authority compartment.

The design explicitly creates a narrow operation capability; it does not pretend ordinary INVOKER SQL can bypass raw-column ACL. It rejects raw SELECT grants, owner views and SECURITY DEFINER fallback. A future backend/source projection primitive must independently prove exact internal authority, caller gate, system-catalog scope and complete effects. No current privilege or installation is claimed.

Reader caller/session/effective identity, independent own-session bridge context and source-free local compartment are distinct. No ownership/membership elevation, superuser, BYPASSRLS or monitoring-role grant is selected.

Potentially sensitive config/body processing is disclosed inside trusted acquisition membrane; no raw bytes enter Reader-facing frames or diagnostics. Config output is approved assertions only; eight body digests are approved integrity representations, never effect/authority proof. Secret stores and raw secret retrieval remain forbidden.

Frame and predicate stages receive bounded immutable values plus protected manifests, without SQL/session descriptor or reacquisition capability. Unknown or malformed inputs reject; all predicate conjunctions require complete evidence.

Preserves four public source fields and two separately attributed accepted own-process LOGIN facts, with two independent native observers and fixed session/process/generation binding. No pg_read_all_stats or new native participant.

Eight fixed entry contracts and nine abstract primitive effect classes define permitted behavior. Actual machine functions are not falsely enumerated or proved. Every implicit type I/O, operator, default, support/language handler and explicit call must refine a class with complete source effects before acceptance; unknown calls reject rather than being inferred harmless.

Model D is selected. Broad monitoring, generic catalog access and standalone fixed-query approaches are rejected or incomplete. Source authority, object breadth, SQL freedom, credential propagation and runtime freedom are explicitly constrained.

All 19 requested threats have explicit rejection/containment rules. Physical implementation defects remain material future acceptance risks, not evidence of current safety or concealed current design permissions.

remaining_acceptance_obligations: Bind actual source callsites, exact internal catalog authorization, all explicit/implicit call effects and source replacement protections to this design.
Audit complete PostgreSQL effective role/PUBLIC/default ACL paths independently; design opcode confinement is not ACL proof.
Implement and prove descriptor custody and transport API confinement with no caller-accessible generic statement channel.
Bind projected config/body boundaries, error/log/memory handling and finite resource bounds before activation.
Verify protected enrollment/effect manifest provenance, freshness, source identity and change rejection; hash alone cannot authorize.
Bind all 16 semantic gaps later. This review leaves them OPEN and leaves the existing 17 closure failures unchanged.
decision: Approve G1/G2 as reviewable normative design only. Later binding must reject nonconforming implementations; do not close graph or run Reader ACL in this gate.
